name: ARRL International DX (W/VE side)
description: Work DX only. Exchange: RST + power. 3 points per QSO. Multipliers are DXCC entities.

name: ARRL November Sweepstakes
description: Exchange: serial, precedence, your call, check (year licensed), ARRL/RAC section. 2 points per QSO; each station may be worked once. Multipliers are the 85 sections.

name: CQ WPX
description: Exchange: RST + serial. Points: other continent 3, same continent 1 (2 within North America), own country 1; doubled on 160/80/40 m. Multipliers are unique prefixes, counted once.

name: CQ World Wide DX
description: Exchange: RST + CQ zone. Points: other continent 3, same continent 1 (2 within North America), own country 0. Multipliers are zones plus DXCC entities.

name: Custom / simple
description: Free-text exchange. Fixed points per QSO, multiplier by DXCC entity, grid square or none.

name: ARRL Field Day
description: Exchange: class + section. Phone 1 pt, CW/digital 2 pts. No multipliers (bonus points are not tracked).

name: IARU HF Championship
description: Exchange: RST + ITU zone (HQ stations send their society abbreviation). Points: same zone 1, same continent 3, other continent 5, HQ stations 1. Multipliers are ITU zones + HQ stations.

name: North American QSO Party
description: Exchange: name + state/province/country. 1 point per QSO. Multipliers are states, provinces and North American countries.

name: New England QSO Party (NE station)
description: Exchange: RST + location. New England stations send their county (e.g. WORMA); others send state, province or "DX". Phone 1 pt, CW/digital 2 pts. Multipliers: states, provinces and DXCC entities.

name: New Hampshire QSO Party (out-of-state)
description: For stations outside NH working NH stations. Exchange: RS(T) + the NH county they send. Phone 1 pt, CW/digital 2 pts. Multiplier is each NH county, counted once (the official once-per-band count, max 50, is not applied).

name: Texas QSO Party (out-of-state)
description: For stations outside Texas working Texas stations. Exchange: RS(T) + the Texas county they send. Phone 2 pts, CW/digital 3 pts. Multiplier is each Texas county, counted once (max 254). Mobile-worked bonus points are not tracked.

name: WAE DX Contest (non-European side)
description: Work Europe only. Exchange: RST + serial. 1 point per QSO. Multipliers are WAE countries, counted once (single-band operation assumed; the official per-band weighting is not applied). QTC traffic is not tracked.
